unit.why: A minimal anecdote: the master once placed a great tzaddik's kvitl inside his holy manuscript book and declared that from there anyone could obtain salvation; it is an act plus a saying, so it barely counts as a narrative.

stories.start_quote: פ"א הניח מורינו קוויטל של גדול
stories.summary_en: The master once placed the kvitl of a great tzaddik inside his holy handwritten book and said that from it anyone could find salvation in children, life and livelihood.

quotes: שמשם יוכל כל אדם להיות לו ישועה
tags.why: The tzaddik's power to bring salvation to others through his kvitl and book
His holy manuscript book is used as a vessel of power
Part of a list of the master's praises

missing_concepts: kvitl (petition note) as a sacred object
blessing for children, life and sustenance (בני חיי ומזוני)
